title: BIAS AND FAIRNESS IN CHATBOTS: AN OVERVIEW
benchmark_measurement: The paper cites an example of a benchmark measuring stereotypical association, specifically how a prompt containing the keyword for a religious group ('Muslim') might trigger stereotypical and negative results ('Terrorist').
findings: The paper provides an example from cited research indicating that large language models can exhibit stereotypical biases. Specifically, a prompt containing the keyword 'Muslim' might elicit responses related to 'Terrorist', demonstrating how user prompts can trigger biased outputs in chatbots.
